description: Make or change Glass (glass/): a solid of clear glass that follows the reader's pointer over a page of words or a Garden drawing, refracting it, and melts from one shape into the next (ring, tetrahedron, octahedron, sphere, rounded cube, capsule), raymarched as signed distance fields in one WebGL2 shader; the pages under it melt into one another as 2D distance fields. Use for a new shape, a glass that reads as plastic or as a flat lens, refraction that tears or swims, a shadow that floats, new words or drawings under the glass, a melt between pages, colours by day or night, or a stage that drops frames, even if the user never says "skill".
